thread:
eng-oncall-bot: Pager alert: genqueue US-WEST high error rate (5xx) — paging Sam (oncall) & ops-bridge. Incident ID INC-3098

Sam (oncall): seeing it, joining bridge now. fresh pager details?

ops-bridge-bot: Bridge started: https://meet.example/ops-3098765432 — invite sent to participants

Lee (infra): I can see genqueue queues spiking, worker OOMs on g4dn. tail logs:
```
2026-03-17T16:12:02Z genqueue[worker-12]: kv_cache insert failed: out_of_memory
2026-03-17T16:12:03Z genqueue[worker-12]: reconnecting
```

Sam (oncall): good catch. rolling a capacity bump and drain worker-12. Maria (sre) can you assess customer impact for status page?

Maria (sre): quick check: ~2% of requests in US-WEST failing with 500 for text-generation endpoints; higher latency for streaming. Affected customers: several enterprise customers hitting dedicated pools and hosted customers on US-WEST region. Draft initial status copy below:

```
We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in US-West. Engineers are investigating and routing traffic to fallback capacity. Some requests may see higher latency or failures. No customer data loss is expected. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

Jordan (comms): tweak "routing traffic to fallback capacity" -> "temporarily redirecting requests to alternate capacity to reduce errors" and add expected user-facing impact: "intermittent 500s and higher latency for text generation in US-WEST; endpoints unaffected in other regions." Also flag for Legal if we mention "no data loss."

Tanya (legal): Confirmed — "no customer data loss" ok for initial, but keep as "no known data loss at this time."

Sam (oncall): copying amended text:

```
We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in US-West. Engineers are temporarily redirecting requests to alternate capacity to reduce errors. Users in US-West may experience intermittent 500s and increased latency for text generation. Other regions are not affected. No known customer data loss at this time. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

Sam (oncall): Publishing initial status post now. @Jordan please push to status page and send customer digest to enterprise cohort.

Jordan (comms): Published to status, customer digest queued. sending now :mailbox_with_mail: 

Lee (infra): mitigation: drained problematic node pool, scaled up fallback nodes, KV cache eviction enabled. monitoring tail:
```
genqueue error-rate: dropping from 6% -> 0.8% over 4 min
latency p95: from 1.8s -> 900ms
```

Maria (sre): seeing partial recovery. recommend holding on public "resolved" until stable for 30m. I'll schedule the 15m update now: statuspage patch below.

Sam (oncall): status update draft for 15m:

```
Update: Mitigation in progress — traffic is being redirected to fallback capacity and error rates are decreasing. We are monitoring and will provide a further update within 30 minutes.
```

Jordan (comms): sent update. I'll add note to customers impacted that we're monitoring and will confirm when fully restored.

ops-bridge-bot: Reminder: post resolved message when error-rate <0.5% for 30 consecutive minutes.

Lee (infra): rolling hotfix to fix KV cache leak that caused OOMs; will deploy to canary first.

Sam (oncall): hotfix deployed to canary, metrics look good. preparing canary->prod rollout.

Maria (sre): error-rate steady at 0.2% for last 20m, p95 stable. hold 10m more before resolve.

Jordan (comms): prepping resolved copy and postmortem blurb.

Sam (oncall): final resolve copy:

```
Resolved: Full service restored. Root cause: a KV cache growth bug causing worker OOMs in genqueue under specific load patterns. Mitigations included redirecting traffic to fallback capacity and a hotfix to evict stale cache entries. We are rolling the fix to all workers and monitoring. No known customer data loss at this time. Postmortem will be shared when available.
```

Tanya (legal): ok

Jordan (comms): published resolved update and emailed affected enterprise customers. :white_check_mark: 

Sam (oncall): good job team. filing incident ticket INC-3098 and assigning to Lee for RCA. :thumbsup: 

Lee (infra): on it, will include timeline and stack traces. Closing bridge in 10.

ops-bridge-bot: Bridge closed. Logs and recording saved to: https://storage.example/ops/INC-3098/recording

Maria (sre): tagging follow-up tasks in Jira: INC-3098-rca & INC-3098-postmortem. Thanks.
